title: Chicken tagine with chickpeas, carrots and lemon
steps: Chop the onion, garlic and ginger and cut the carrots into thick slices.
Salt the chicken and brown it all over in the oil in a casserole, then remove.
Sweat the onion, garlic, ginger and spices for 3 minutes, add the chicken, carrots, stock and cinnamon stick and braise covered for 25 minutes.
Add the chickpeas, olives and lemon wedges and braise for 10 more minutes.
Soak the couscous in 120 ml hot salted water and serve with the tagine and coriander.
